metadata.description: Claude Code skill that turns a folder of vlog / travel footage into a story-driven rough-cut draft for JianYing Pro (剪映专业版 11.6, macOS).

plugins.name: jianying-autocut
plugins.description: Understand footage with Xiaomi MiMo, write a story plan (hook / build-up / turn / climax / ending), pick shots by chapter quota and pacing, and generate a JianYing draft with chapter titles and BGM.
